item.text: I’m reviewing the current matcher-based design for the next worthwhile refactor. The main gap now is cohesion inside `KmpMatcher`: it has cached analysis state, but several query methods still rescan the text instead of consistently using one result model.

I found a real design flaw to fix: `KmpMatcher` currently caches results while holding a raw `CharSequence`, so a mutable input like `StringBuilder` can make cached analysis stale. I’m snapping matcher text to an immutable `String`, turning `KmpMatchResult` into a context-aware search result, and then delegating matcher queries through that stable result model.
The snapshotting refactor is in. I’m compiling and running the packaged tests and demo now; I expect any fallout to be around imports or the widened `KmpMatchResult` contract.

item.text: The refactor is behaving correctly, including the new pattern/text-aware result output. I’m removing the temporary `out/` tree and then I’ll summarize the design change.

Refactored the search session and result model around stable, context-aware data. [KmpMatcher.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatcher.java:12) now snapshots `text` to an immutable `String`, so cached analysis can’t go stale if a caller passes a mutable `CharSequence` like `StringBuilder`. Its query methods now delegate through the cached `KmpMatchResult` instead of mixing cached and rescanned code paths.

[KmpMatchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatchResult.java:10) now carries the searched `pattern` and `text`, and it implements `Iterable<Integer>`, which makes it a more complete search outcome object rather than just a wrapped list of indices. I updated the demo in [KmpSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/demo/KmpSearchDemo.java:9) to show that richer result, and extended [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/test/java/com/example/kmp/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:6) with snapshot/caching coverage for mutable input.

Verified with `javac -d out $(rg --files -g '*.java' src/main/java src/test/java)`, `java -cp out com.example.kmp.KmpSearchSelfTest`, `java -cp out com.example.kmp.demo.KmpSearchDemo`, and `java -cp out com.example.kmp.demo.KmpSearchDemo xyz a`.
